g.text: Upper-layer training · evaluation update 768 · frozen-source curves

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #86868b

g.text: Development determines checkpoint selection; final serving evaluations are separate.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #86868b

g.text: Ordinary reference: frozen native tail on each source cache; not whole-model generation.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #86868b

g.text: Top bands: pointwise 95% family-cluster bootstrap (paired prompts if family metadata are absent).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #86868b

g.text: Family clusters do not cover all shared-context dependence. Ordinary-chat aggregate curves have no confidence bands.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #86868b

g.text: One fit/runtime; an all-correct band does not prove perfect accuracy. Fresh prompts are evaluated only after selection.
